name: Nathanael (Bartholomew)
life: The Holy Apostle Nathanael, identified by many Fathers with the Apostle Bartholomew, was born at Cana of Galilee and was one of the Twelve Apostles of Christ. He and the Apostle Philip preached throughout Syria, Asia Minor, and Phrygia, enduring imprisonment and persecution. He later preached in India and Great Armenia, where he was martyred — flayed alive and beheaded — in the city of Albanopolis by order of King Astiag.
